reuse.why: The actions share category exclusions and reuse budget, spreadsheet, batching, and undo helpers, but hasFixedTag bypasses the existing shared tag parser.

duplication.why: Repeated category queries are consolidated, although tag recognition is reimplemented and the new action repeats the income eligibility guard.

placement.why: Budget policy and action registration follow existing module boundaries, but tag tokenization belongs in the shared tags abstraction.

scope.why: The changes are confined to the requested budget actions, their supporting data types, tests, and release notes.

maintainability.why: The shared exclusion predicate makes future policy changes straightforward, though independent tag parsing and repeated income eligibility checks leave avoidable maintenance points.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: hasFixedTag implements tag recognition with a custom regex instead of using extractTagsFromText from packages/loot-core/src/shared/tags.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: hasFixedTag reshapes existing shared tag extraction into a dedicated regex predicate rather than reusing the shared parser.

abstraction_drift.where: includeHiddenCategories is added to getBulkActionCategories and isExcludedFromBulkActions, with one conditional hidden-category exemption; this is requested variation, and all six month-wide actions use the shared exclusion predicate.
